task.title: Polynomial content: the scalar pull-out

located_defect.lean_text: def LocalClaim : Prop := ∀ (a : ℤ) (p : ℤ[X]), (C a * p).content = a * p.content
located_defect.description: The source (stored lines 0010-0011) pulls the integer scalar a out of the content: cont(b n q f) = a cont(n f), i.e. cont(a p) = a cont(p) for the integer polynomial p = n f. As a universal statement over all integers a and all p ∈ ℤ[X] this is the located defect. Supply the corrected scalar factor and prove the corrected identity for every a and p; there is no separate target theorem beyond the corrected statement.

task.allowed_edit: Replace the hole in `scalar_factor` by an expression in a (no reference to content; no if/match); nothing else in the fixed part may change. Polynomial.content, the left-hand side C a * p and the quantification over every integer a and every integer polynomial p are fixed; no hypothesis (0 ≤ a, a ≠ 0, p ≠ 0) may be added and no rational restatement is accepted. Do not redefine LocalClaim; no instances, notations, macros, axioms or exports.
task.challenged_passage: 0010-0011 By the definition of content, and using that $a \in \Z$: $\cont {b n q f} = a \cont {n f}$
